Uniform k>=mW floor when one odd q clears the frame lattice and each qC_i mod 2 is invertible. Its stated open question leaves even-denominator frames and singular cleared targets out of scope and suggests a dyadic example.
predecessors.distinction: This package uses a denominator-four address lattice and four 2x2 rank-two targets. At the minimal target clearing q=2, every qC_i mod 2 has rank one, so the odd-lattice theorem hypothesis fails. This package checks every six-call word for this one dyadic instance; it proves no general even-denominator theorem.
